zh: 新增快捷语音输入与草稿箱快捷入口，本地库名称也支持直接修改。
持续调整 UI 与语音输入体验，优化录音路由、队列同步与通知提醒表现。
修复附件导出异常、文件锁冲突，并保留仅本地备忘录状态，同时取消标签统一小写限制。
en: Added quick voice input and a faster draft-box entry point, and local libraries can now be renamed directly.
Continued refining the UI and voice-input flow with better recording routing, sync queue behavior, and notification indicators.
Fixed attachment export failures, file-lock conflicts, and local-only memo state retention, while also removing the forced lowercase tag rule.

zh: 草稿箱支持从工具栏快速进入
新增通知菜单与抽屉提醒角标
en: Drafts can now be opened directly from the toolbar.
Local library names can now be edited.
Added a notification menu and drawer badge reminders.

zh: 优化快捷语音与语音输入界面
优化录音路由与队列同步
取消标签统一小写规范，保留原始大小写
en: Improved quick voice and voice input screens.
Optimized recording routing and sync queue behavior.
Removed the forced lowercase tag rule to preserve original casing.

zh: 修复仅本地备忘录状态容易丢失的问题
en: Fixed local-only memo state getting lost.
